title: Hardware-Accelerated Passive Intrusion Detection System for IoT (IDS-IoT)
summary: An end-to-end pipeline for a hardware-accelerated IoT intrusion detection system, covering feature selection, DNN training, model compression, and FPGA deployment via hls4ml on the CIC-IoT-2023 dataset. To counter extreme class imbalance in multiclass attack profiling, the standalone ctgan package's CTGANSynthesizer is fit on minority-class data and sampled to generate synthetic packets for augmentation.
